[[Kuudra]] Infernal Tier Completion }} '''Hollow Armor''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Armor]] set. There are 4 upgraded tiers of Hollow Armor: '''Hot''', '''Burning''', '''Fiery''', and '''Infernal''', which can all be obtained by prestiging the previous tier. == Obtaining == Basic Tier '''Hollow Armor''' Pieces can be obtained from [[Kuudra#Reward Chests|Paid Reward Chests]] at the end of a [[Kuudra]] fight. ;Piece Drop Chances *Basic Tier: {{Green|4.31%}} *Hot Tier: {{Green|4.2%}} *Burning Tier: {{Green|4.05%}} *Fiery Tier: {{Green|3.91%}} *Infernal Tier: {{Green|4.08%}} Higher tiers of '''Hollow Armor''' can be obtained by prestiging the previous tier at a Blacksmith, which can be done if it has 10 [[Star Upgrades|Stars]] applied to it. Each {{Gold|Spirit ⚶}} stack can be used as charge for the {{Gold|Hollow Wand}}. |tiered_bonus_required_pieces = 2+ }} Upon having at least 2 pieces equipped, the {{AN|Tiered Set Bonus: Spirit}} is unlocked. When the wearer of the armor or up to 4 other players within 25 blocks hits an enemy, the wearer gains 1 stack, with a cooldown dependent on how many pieces are worn - 3s if wearing 2 pieces, 2s if wearing 3, and 1s if wearing all 4. This cooldown is player-dependent and not armor-dependent, meaning if 3 pieces of '''Hollow Armor''' are worn, up to 5 charges can be gained every 2 seconds if the wearer and 4 other players all attack enemies. The maximum number of stacks is determined by the lowest prestige tier among the equipped '''Hollow Armor''' pieces. Magic damage can also grant stacks. These stacks do not do anything by themselves but are used to cast spells from the [[Hollow Wand]]. == Essence Crafting == |-|Basic = {{Essence Crafting |type = a |essence = Crimson |30 |35 |40 |45
